content_sections.heading: About GEU Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Graphic Era (Deemed to be) University, located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, operates as an educational institution offering various undergraduate and postgraduate programs. This recruitment drive is conducted by the university to fill an academic position within the Department of Business Management.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification details a single vacancy under the Department of Business Management.

rows.qualification: Master’s Degree in Commerce/Accounting/Finance or a relevant/allied discipline with at least 60% marks. Professional qualification in ACCA/CA/CMA. Ph.D. is desirable.
rows.experience: Relevant teaching and/or industry experience in Accounting, Financial Reporting, Audit, Taxation, Financial Management or related areas.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The salary is provided as per the University norms. Extremely lucrative salary will be offered to the exceptional candidates with proven track record. The official notification does not mention specific allowances, tenure duration, or service bond conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GEU Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Prepare your comprehensive Curriculum Vitae (CV). Open your email client and compose a new message addressed to [email protected] . Set the exact subject line of the email to Application for the post of Assistant Professor, ACCA, DBM, GEU . Attach your CV to the email. Send the email on or before 26th October 2026 up to 1700 Hrs.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae (CV) Proof of educational and professional qualifications (Master’s Degree, ACCA/CA/CMA certificates, Ph.D. if applicable) Documents supporting relevant teaching and/or industry experience

rows.details: Visit the Graphic Era University portal

faq.answer: The email subject line must be exactly "Application for the post of Assistant Professor, ACCA, DBM, GEU".
